text_block_list.text:
A little while has passed since the Yayoi
Sho, and
summer camp season has come.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Сайленс Судзука knows she must become
faster,
but she's plagued with concern
because of how
heavy and
uncooperative her legs are.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
It's a disquieting start for this year's
summer
camp.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
